changelog_text:
Now supports fixed crew characters: a character mod can now name crew that every new game starts with, the way the game always starts with Hunter, Banjo and Polaris. With KSP Characters 0.5.0 or later, that's Jebediah, Bill, Bob and Valentina Kerman.

- They join a new game's roster right after Hunter, Banjo and Polaris, each in place of a random recruit, so the roster keeps its size.
- Only while their mod is ticked under Roster Character Models.
- In a Testing start, the game seats the first two in the starting vehicles: Jeb and Bill.
- "Regenerate unused recruits" leaves them alone, like the game's three.
- Saves that already exist are not changed.

For mod authors: add [[crew]] entries (name, character) to your characters.toml; see the README.

listing.abstract: Choose which character mods your crew roster draws from, and give recruits the names and fixed crew their mod provides.
listing.description:
Choose which character mods your crew roster draws from, and give recruits the names and fixed crew their mod provides.

**It does nothing on its own.** It manages the characters that other mods add, such as KSP Characters, and works with any character mod.

Open it in game from **View > Mods > Characters**. The features, and the format for character mod authors, are in the [README](https://github.com/paulo-santana/KSA-Character-Manager#readme).
